summary: No evidence of installer-side harm in @zannstore/baileys@2.4.4
details: No static or traced findings were produced for this package version. The package name suggests a fork or republish of the Baileys WhatsApp library family, but no code in this version was flagged as performing credential theft, install-time remote execution, silent relay, backdoor installation, or dependency-tree dropper behavior. Without concrete evidence of an installer-facing attack mechanism in the shipped code, this version does not meet the bar for a supply-chain attack advisory.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
